msgHelp: {icoAqi} AQI Notifier Bot v{botVersion} This bot monitors air quality data from your sensors and sends notifications about AQI and/or PM values transitions between pollution zones or their sudden changes. Main commands: /list — list your devices and manage subscriptions to them /status — latest received indicators for all your devices /history — history of the last 10 measurements for all your devices /help — main menu and this help /lang — change interface language and units Management: {icoBullet} Click Settings -> Subscriptions to add or remove a device. {icoBullet} In the «Settings» section you can change zone thresholds for PM indicators (Green/Yellow/Red) and the list of generated notifications. {icoBullet} You can also configure which notifications will come with sound and which silently.
